name: PR review
description: Every pull request read against your team's own rules before anyone reviews it, and the small clean ones merged without anyone having to: the rules come from the files your repositories already have and the review comments your team keeps writing, every push gets a round with a ledger of each rule and findings on their lines, and an inbox says who each pull request waits on.
